question: According to Census of India 2011, which state in India has the lowest literacy rate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the Census of India 2011:-
 
 
• **Bihar has the lowest literacy rate among all states in India.**
 
• The literacy rate in Bihar was recorded at 63.82% in the 2011 census, which is significantly lower than the national average of 74.04%.
 
• This indicates that there is a significant gap in education and literacy levels between Bihar and other states in India.
 
• The state government has implemented several initiatives to improve the literacy rate, such as the Bihar Education Project and the Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jharkhand**:

 
 
• Jharkhand has a literacy rate of 66.41%, which is higher than Bihar but still lower than the national average.
 
• The state has made efforts to improve education through schemes like the Mukhyamantri Sukanya Yojana and the Jharkhand Education Project.
 
 
 
• **Rajasthan**:
 
 
• Rajasthan has a literacy rate of 66.11%, which is again lower than the national average.
 
• The state government has implemented several initiatives to improve education, such as the Bhamashah Yojana and the Rajasthan Education Initiative.
 
 
 
• **Arunachal Pradesh: **
 
 
• Arunachal Pradesh has a literacy rate of 66.95%, which is higher than both Jharkhand and Rajasthan but still lower than the national average.
 
• The state has made efforts to improve education through initiatives like the Arunachal Pradesh Education for All Project and the Chief Minister's Universal Health Insurance Scheme.
